Total 8×2=16 dispatches but each moves only 1024 elements. Favorable if per-dispatch latency is low and bandwidth-limited on large payloads.

For 224 ranks this could be 2×112, 4×56, or 8×28 hierarchies. Reduces cross-node traffic by factor of group-size at cost of 8×3=24 total dispatches, beneficial if inter-node bandwidth is bottleneck.
